name: Verify assistant requests missing mandatory details before incident creation
objective: Validate that the assistant does not create an incident until all mandatory details are provided, prompting the user for missing information.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page

steps.expectedResult: The assistant acknowledges but identifies missing mandatory fields

steps.description: Verify the assistant requests additional mandatory details
steps.expectedResult: The assistant asks for specific details (e.g., what exactly is the issue, when did it start, who is affected)

steps.description: Verify no incident is created before all mandatory fields are provided
steps.expectedResult: No incident number or confirmation is shown; the assistant continues gathering information
